headline: ONEOK (OKE) Stock Stays Reasonable On Its 126% Five Year Run
summary: ONEOK stock has delivered a 125.6% total return over the past five years, yet the current US$89.46 share price still sits at a discount to where a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiples both place the company. For investors, that raises the question of whether the recent gains have been enough to close the valuation gap or if there is still a margin between price and value.
